title: POA Expiry Within Ninety Days
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=poa:record days_until_expiry=* poa_status=*
| where days_until_expiry<=90 AND days_until_expiry>=0 AND poa_status="active"
| sort days_until_expiry
| table poa_type agent_name days_until_expiry jurisdiction
description: Lists active powers of attorney expiring within the next ninety days.
value: Expired POA documents fail exactly when a family crisis needs them; early renewal avoids court delays.
implementation: Include `days_until_expiry` and `poa_status` on each POA record and review quarterly with your attorney.
visualization: Table of POAs sorted by days until expiry.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks power-of-attorney documents that expire soon and need renewal.
